user.title: Set up APmeter SEM
user.description: Enter the APmeter IP address and a name for the meter.

data_description.tcp_enabled: Reads the power values (total and L1-L3) about every second over the meter's local TCP port 3333, the same channel the EZHI uses for Local Control. Unencrypted, local network only. Voltage, current, power factor and energy still come via HTTP.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the APmeter SEM. Check the IP address and port.
error.tcp_cannot_connect: The meter did not answer on the fast power port. Check that Home Assistant can reach the meter on this port, or switch off fast power to use HTTP only.
error.tcp_invalid_frame: The meter answered on the fast power port, but the data was invalid. Switch off fast power to use HTTP only.
error.tcp_id_mismatch: The meter ID on the fast power port does not match this device. Check the IP address, or switch off fast power to use HTTP only.

abort.cannot_connect: The discovered meter did not answer via HTTP.
abort.not_apmeter: The discovered device is not an APsystems meter.
